name: use-cases
title: Use cases explorer
description: Tabbed use-case selector with code examples and optional automatic progression.
usage: Showing what the API does through short code samples, four to eight of them. Each item takes `samples` (every SDK language with its install command) and shows them in the code tabs window with the install footer, on the page's remembered language. `glyph` takes a PersonaGlyph for the list (as the site draws it); `actions` can be a function of the sample showing, so a "Try in" button can carry its code. `UseCaseTryIn` groups the open-in-an-agent buttons in the window's chrome bar; The window sits on the ring pattern by default, as on the site (`pattern={false}` leaves it plain; `backdrop` puts your own picture behind it).
avoid: Pill tabs here (the list is Context.dev's tinted sidebar)
Code that changes the card's height between tabs
A language picker per window (the page shares one)

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
